claims.quote: We have high towers; the highest about half a mile in height;
claims.description: The narrator's society has towers about half a mile tall, some on mountains, used for observing weather.

claims.quote: We have also pools, of which some do strain fresh water out of salt; and others by art do turn fresh water into salt.
claims.description: Pools will desalinate seawater into fresh water, and others will make fresh water salty by artificial means.

claims.quote: And amongst them we have a water which we call Water of Paradise, being, by that we do to it made very sovereign for health, and prolongation of life.
claims.description: An artificially prepared mineral water will greatly prolong life and improve health.

claims.quote: We have also great and spacious houses where we imitate and demonstrate meteors; as snow, hail, rain, some artificial rains of bodies and not of water, thunders, lightnings;
claims.description: Enclosed halls will produce artificial snow, hail, rain, thunder and lightning on demand.

claims.quote: We make a number of kinds of serpents, worms, flies, fishes, of putrefaction; whereof some are advanced (in effect) to be perfect creatures, like bests or birds; and have sexes, and do propagate.
claims.description: Living creatures such as worms, flies and fish will be produced from decaying matter and will reproduce sexually.

claims.quote: Neither do we this by chance, but we know beforehand, of what matter and commixture what kind of those creatures will arise.
claims.description: Scientists will predict which organisms arise from a given mix of matter before the organisms appear.

claims.quote: We find means to make commixtures and copulations of different kinds; which have produced many new kinds, and them not barren, as the general opinion is.
claims.description: Crossbreeding of different animal kinds will produce new, fertile hybrid species.

claims.quote: By art likewise, we make them greater or taller than their kind is; and contrariwise dwarf them, and stay their growth:
claims.description: Animals will be artificially enlarged or dwarfed beyond their natural size.

claims.quote: Wherein we find many strange effects; as continuing life in them, though divers parts, which you account vital, be perished and taken forth; resuscitating of some that seem dead in appearance; and the like.
claims.description: Animals will go on living after vital organs are removed, and some apparently dead will be revived.

claims.quote: We make them also by art greater much than their nature; and their fruit greater and sweeter and of differing taste, smell, colour, and figure, from their nature.
claims.description: Plants will be bred to yield larger and sweeter fruit with altered taste, smell, color and shape.

claims.quote: And we make (by art) in the same orchards and gardens, trees and flowers to come earlier or later than their seasons;
claims.description: Trees and flowers will be made to bloom and bear fruit earlier or later than their natural seasons.

claims.quote: We have also means to make divers plants rise by mixtures of earths without seeds; and likewise to make divers new plants, differing from the vulgar; and to make one tree or plant turn into another.
claims.description: Plants will grow from soil mixtures without seeds, and new plant varieties will be made, even turning one plant into another.

claims.quote: Instruments also which generate heat only by motion.
claims.description: Machines will produce heat directly from mechanical motion.

claims.quote: We find also divers means, yet unknown to you, of producing of light originally from divers bodies.
claims.description: New methods will produce light directly from a variety of materials.

claims.quote: We have also helps for the sight, far above spectacles and glasses in use.
claims.description: Vision aids far superior to spectacles will be available.

claims.quote: and out of things uncoloured and transparent, we can represent unto you all several colours; not in rain-bows, (as it is in gems, and prisms,) but of themselves single.
claims.description: Colors will be produced from colorless transparent materials without using prisms or rainbows.

claims.quote: We represent small sounds as great and deep; likewise great sounds extenuate and sharp;
claims.description: Devices will make small sounds loud and deep and loud sounds soft and sharp.

claims.quote: We have also means to convey sounds in trunks and pipes, in strange lines and distances.
claims.description: Sound will be carried over long distances through pipes and channels.

claims.quote: We represent and imitate all articulate sounds and letters, and the voices and notes of beasts and birds.
claims.description: Machines will reproduce human speech and animal calls exactly.

claims.quote: We have certain helps which set to the ear do further the hearing greatly.
claims.description: Devices will greatly improve hearing.

claims.quote: We imitate smells, making all smells to breathe outs of other mixtures than those that give them.
claims.description: Artificial scents will be made from mixtures unrelated to the source of the smell.

claims.quote: We have ships and boats for going under water, and brooking of seas; also swimming-girdles and supporters.
claims.description: Ships and boats will travel underwater and across rough seas, with flotation aids for swimmers.

claims.quote: We imitate also flights of birds; we have some degrees of flying in the air.
claims.description: Humans will achieve some degree of powered flight.

claims.quote: We have divers curious clocks, and other like motions of return: and some perpetual motions.
claims.description: Machines that run forever without an energy source will exist.

claims.quote: new mixtures and compositions of gun-powder, wild-fires burning in water, and unquenchable.
claims.description: New explosives and incendiaries will burn underwater and cannot be put out.

claims.quote: We imitate also motions of living creatures, by images, of men, beasts, birds, fishes, and serpents.
claims.description: Lifelike mechanical figures of humans and animals will move like living creatures.

claims.quote: We have some meats also and breads and drinks, which taken by men enable them to fast long after; and some other, that used make the very flesh of men's bodies sensibly more hard and tough and their strength far greater than otherwise it would be.
claims.description: Foods and drinks will allow long fasting and make the body far stronger.

claims.quote: so that divers, especially in age, do desire to live with them, with little or no meat or bread.
claims.description: Some drinks will be nourishing enough that elderly people can live on them with little other food.

claims.quote: We have also certain chambers, which we call Chambers of Health, where we qualify the air as we think good and proper for the cure of divers diseases, and preservation of health.
claims.description: Rooms with controlled air will be used to cure diseases and preserve health.

claims.quote: And we do also declare natural divinations of diseases, plagues, swarms-of hurtful creatures, scarcity, tempests, earthquakes, great inundations, comets, temperature of the year, and divers other things;
claims.description: Forecasts of disease, plagues, storms, earthquakes, floods and harvests will be issued in advance.

claims.quote: But above all, we have heats, in imitation of the Sun's and heavenly bodies' heats, that pass divers inequalities, and (as it were) orbs, progresses, and returns, whereby we produce admirable effects.
claims.description: Artificial heat sources will imitate the varying heat of the sun and planets.
